summary: Citizens Community Bancorp Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 27, 2026 to announce its Q1 2026 earnings of $0.39 per diluted share and a quarterly dividend of $0.105 per share. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing covers Items 2.02 (Results of Operations), 8.01 (Other Events—dividend), and 9.01 (Exhibits). No acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is involved. The board approved the dividend on April 24, payable May 22. The filing is a standard current report; no special-situation classification applies.
